params.body:
Every project calls this workflow at `@v1`, so a commit on `main` reaches the whole fleet the moment the tag moves. Moving it was a manual step, and it went wrong twice in one day: after the file plan and after the npm-cache fix, `v1` stayed on the commit before, and the fleet kept running a runner whose bug was already fixed. Both times the fix was merged and only the tag was waiting.

`tag.yml` moves it on a green test run on `main` (`workflow_run`, `conclusion == success`), idempotently, and logs which commit it moved from and to.

This is only safe because of elixir-fix#8 earlier today: without tests on this repo, an automatic moving tag would be the opposite of a gate — it would push every merge straight to every project unverified. With them, the gate is the thing that releases.
params.title: v1 verzet zichzelf, en alleen als de tests groen zijn
